name: Boolean Sensitivity
definition: For a Boolean test $T\subseteq\{0,1\}^Y$, the sensitivity at a word is the number of one-coordinate flips that change membership in $T$; $s(1_T)$ is the maximum sensitivity over all words.
parameters: A Boolean test, equivalently its indicator function on a displayed cube.
normalization: Inactive displayed coordinates contribute no sensitive flips.
